# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **API documentation delivery**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 delivers compiler XML documentation alongside packages and refreshes the bundled m154 renderer. The release also keeps HarfBuzzSharp bindings synchronized with the bundled native source and improves generated interop maintenance.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m154 upstream fixes** — Updates the bundled Skia m154 renderer with the latest upstream corrections, including buffer-upload fixes. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation** — Packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation so IDE tooltips and API references can use the managed API comments directly. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
- **Generated binding maintenance** — Generated P/Invoke declarations are organized by type, making the native interop surface easier to maintain while preserving the managed API. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **HarfBuzz bindings follow bundled native source** — HarfBuzzSharp binding generation now follows the same pinned HarfBuzz source used to build the bundled native library, keeping supported declarations synchronized. — ❤️ [@azchohfi](https://github.com/azchohfi) ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057), [#5111](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5111))
